bias_physical_mechanisms.temporal_compositing_window: Landsat uses 90-day multi-temporal median composite (March 1 - June 1) capturing persistent peak summer thermal inertia, whereas MODIS monthly May average reflects daily cloud-cleared passes.
bias_physical_mechanisms.view_zenith_angle: MODIS scans off-nadir across wide swaths (angles up to +/-65 degrees), integrating vertical building walls and shadows in street canyons; Landsat operates near-nadir (+/-7.5 degrees), directly viewing horizontal sunlit roofs and asphalt.
bias_physical_mechanisms.emissivity_algorithm: MODIS MOD11A1 uses split-window coefficients based on static land cover maps, while Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 dynamically scales thermal emissivity using ASTER Global Emissivity Dataset (ASTER-GED) coupled with fractional vegetation cover.
